name: Chilli Tofu
steps: Press tofu for 15 minutes, cut into cubes and pat dry. Toss with 30 g cornstarch and salt until lightly coated.
Heat 35 ml oil in a wide pan. Pan-fry tofu in one layer for 3 minutes per side until crisp and golden; transfer to a plate.
Heat remaining oil and stir-fry garlic, ginger and green chilies for 30 seconds. Add onion petals and capsicum; toss over high heat for 3 minutes, keeping them crisp.
Mix soy sauce, chili sauce, vinegar, water and remaining 10 g cornstarch. Pour into the pan and cook 1–2 minutes, stirring until glossy and lightly thickened.
Return tofu and toss quickly so every cube is coated. Finish with spring onions and serve immediately before the tofu loses its crisp edges.
tips: Use a vegetarian chili sauce and press tofu well; a hot pan gives crisp cubes without deep-frying.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
